evidence.observation: Before growth, pressure was 3.088 Torr and exhaust oxygen 6.4 ppm at approximately 100 sccm Ar.
Growth pressure was 3.095 Torr and oxygen 8.4 ppm.
Pressure rose to 3.151 Torr and oxygen to 17.1 ppm.
Pressure and oxygen continued rising to 3.210 Torr and 22.9 ppm.
Temperature and Ar track setpoints at 749.9 C and 100.6 sccm, but pressure reaches 3.266 Torr and oxygen 30.8 ppm despite running status; the coupled rise suggests air ingress through a seal leak.

args.missing_evidence: A leak-integrity test is needed to confirm the suspected seal leak and distinguish it from exhaust restriction or sensor error; no sample characterization is available.
